title: Git stacks: resolve relative build contexts and bind mounts against the checkout
description: GitStack compose file is copied to <stackDir>/compose.yaml while the repo lives in <stackDir>/repo, so relative build contexts, bind mounts and env_file paths in the repo's compose file don't resolve. Found in review of shipr-e42.10. Option: run compose with --project-directory set to the compose file's directory inside repo/ (still validated by PathValidationUtil).
acceptance_criteria: A Git stack whose compose file uses a relative bind mount and env_file from the repo deploys and mounts the repo path; paths escaping the repo are still rejected; test with the smart-HTTP stub
close_reason: Git stacks run compose from the checkout, rollback aligns commit (b0f1e6f, 2f322f2)

title: Record old/new values in RETENTION_UPDATE audit details
description: AuditAspect writes details=null; shipr-46j.10 asked for old/new retention values on PUT. Add an Auditable details SpEL attribute (no secrets) and use it for RETENTION_UPDATE.
acceptance_criteria: @Auditable gets an optional details SpEL attribute evaluated after success (access to arguments and the previous state captured before the call); RETENTION_UPDATE writes details {old: {auditLogDays, notificationDays, chatSessionDays}, new: {...}}; actions without the attribute still write details=null; AI marker details are merged, not overwritten; tests in AuditAspectTest and RetentionApiTest.
close_reason: @Auditable before/details SpEL, RETENTION_UPDATE old/new (e92caf6)

title: Enforce at most one LOCAL docker host with a partial unique index
description: HostService (shipr-406.5) checks 'only one LOCAL environment' in the service only. Two concurrent POST /api/hosts with connectionType LOCAL can both pass the check and both be saved, since V6 has no DB constraint for it. Add a migration with a partial unique index on docker_hosts ((connection_type)) WHERE connection_type = 'LOCAL', and map its violation to 409 LOCAL_HOST_EXISTS in HostService (today any DataIntegrityViolationException on save maps to HOST_NAME_TAKEN).
acceptance_criteria: New Flyway migration (next free version at implementation time; V20 is reserved by shipr-f8k.1) adds a partial unique index on docker_hosts (connection_type) WHERE connection_type = 'LOCAL'; SchemaMigrationTest rejects a second LOCAL row; HostService maps that index violation to 409 LOCAL_HOST_EXISTS while a name collision still maps to 409 HOST_NAME_TAKEN; ./backend/mvnw -f backend/pom.xml verify passes.
close_reason: Partial unique index V21 + 409 LOCAL_HOST_EXISTS (1d6f8ea)

title: Any kill event suppresses a real crash for 5 minutes; killedAt only pruned on next kill
description: host/ContainerHealthWatcher.java ~133-138: every kill event (also non-terminating signals like docker kill -s HUP) suppresses the next die of that container for 5 minutes, so a real crash right after can go unreported. killedAt entries are only evicted when another kill arrives (entries of removed hosts or containers that never die linger). Needs the signal attribute on DockerEventDto.
acceptance_criteria: Only terminating signals suppress; killedAt entries are evicted on sync or host removal; tests cover both.

title: Logs UI: O(n) work per incoming line, ANSI codes shown raw, series colours repeat after 8 services, stomp onError untested
description: frontend/src/features/containers/logs: logStream.applyFrame copies the 5000-line buffer per incoming line and LogView re-filters/re-runs findMatches over the whole buffer with a search active and re-renders up to 5000 unmemoized rows (bounded by the backend rate limit; virtualisation / incremental matching would fix it). ANSI escape/control characters are shown as raw text (safe, ugly: strip or render colours). With more than 8 services the --color-series colours repeat (name always shown). shared/realtime/stomp.ts onError has no unit test of its own. Download uses a plain anchor so a 429 TOO_MANY_DOWNLOADS is not shown inline. Two categorical palettes exist (--color-series-1..8 from logs, --color-cat-1..4 from disk usage): unify. apple-design SKILL.md 'Shipir visual language' section does not mention the series tokens.
acceptance_criteria: Bounded per-line work (virtualised or incremental), ANSI handled, one categorical palette documented in the skill, onError tested.

title: PruneCandidatesIntegrationTest in-use image assertion can pass vacuously
description: PruneCandidatesIntegrationTest.candidatesAreStoppedContainersAndUnusedImagesOnly: images.list(...).filteredOn(imageId).allSatisfy(inUse) passes on an empty list. Also the class Javadoc ('Read-only ... removes nothing it did not create') is outdated, and the test fails instead of skipping when alpine:3.20 cannot be pulled offline.
acceptance_criteria: Assertion adds isNotEmpty(); Javadoc matches behaviour; test skips via Assumption when the image cannot be pulled.

title: Final RATE_LIMITED chat error says 'retry in about 5s' when the provider gave no Retry-After
description: ChatOrchestrator.waitSeconds uses the 5 s default when retryAfter is null, so the stored message after exhausted retries claims a provider retry time that is only our default.
acceptance_criteria: Message omits the retry time (or marks it as an estimate) when retryAfter was null.

title: Audit git credential host changes
description: git/GitCredentialService.update: an ADMIN changing a credential's host silently repoints the token for existing deployments; @Auditable details do not record the host.
acceptance_criteria: Audit entry details include old and new host

title: OIDC token/JWKS responses have no size cap; no end-to-end test for denied issuer in settings test
description: auth/oidc/OidcDiscoveryClient.requestFactory(): Spring RestClient/RestTemplate buffer responses without the 1 MiB cap EgressHttpClient uses. Also OidcEgressTest does not cover /api/settings/oidc/test returning UNREACHABLE for a denied issuer through Spring (see WebhookTestDeniedTargetTest pattern).
acceptance_criteria: Response size capped; end-to-end denied-issuer test

title: EgressPolicy does not deny 0.0.0.0/8, 192.0.0.0/24, 198.18.0.0/15
description: common/net/EgressPolicy.isReserved/isAllowed: these special-use ranges are not denied (only 0.0.0.0 itself). Minor hardening.
acceptance_criteria: Ranges denied by default with parameterized tests

title: StompSecurityInterceptor SEND still uses stale handshake isAdmin
description: StompSecurityInterceptor:~146 reads admin from the handshake principal on every SEND. Harmless since consoles are now closed on role change, but StreamAccess.isAdmin(username) (DB-backed) exists for defense in depth.
acceptance_criteria: SEND checks role via StreamAccess or the stale check is removed with justification; test

title: AccessRevalidator evaluates the visibility predicate for every active stream
description: LogStreamHandler.revalidate (~197) and DockerEventStreamService.revalidate (~130) run the predicate (2 DB queries per host) for all active streams before filtering by the user's subscriptions. Check subscription first.
acceptance_criteria: Predicate only called for hosts the user is subscribed to; test

title: Config editor UI: show a clear message for 403 ENV_FILE_RESTRICTED
description: Frontend config editor has no special case for the new 403 ENV_FILE_RESTRICTED on env-like files; viewers see a generic error.
acceptance_criteria: Viewer clicking an env-like file sees an explanatory message

title: Add isExternal() helper to User instead of getExternalIssuer() != null checks
description: auth/UserService, auth/PasswordResetService and auth/oidc/OidcUserResolver check getExternalIssuer() != null in several places; a User.isExternal() helper would name the intent.
acceptance_criteria: Checks use User.isExternal(); behaviour unchanged

title: 2FA code step ignores Retry-After on 429
description: frontend/src/features/auth LoginPage CodeStep uses twoFactorErrors.ts own TOO_MANY_ATTEMPTS text and not throttleMessage/ApiError.retryAfterSeconds (added in shipr-6aj); wording differs from login/reset.
acceptance_criteria: CodeStep shows the Retry-After wait via throttleMessage; component test.

title: Image auto-update: lastResult has no rolled-back state; panel remounts and drops 'Saved.' after save
description: ImageAutoUpdateInfo.lastResult is only APPLIED or FAILED; the finer reason (_ROLLED_BACK/_NOT_ROLLED_BACK) is only in the audit log, so the UI badge says 'Failed, rolled back if possible'. DeploymentDetailPage.tsx:238 keys the panel on enabled+window, so a real save remounts it and the local 'Saved.' status disappears (same pattern as GitSourcePanel). ImageAutoUpdatePanel.test.tsx:57 has a garbled test title.
acceptance_criteria: lastResult distinguishes ROLLED_BACK / FAILED_NOT_ROLLED_BACK and the badge says so; Saved message survives; test renamed.

title: Image auto-update: duplicate DEPLOYMENT_FAILED + IMAGE_UPDATE_FAILED notifications; reason-code wording; stale update flag; no partial-pin test
description: A failed auto-update pull/up publishes DEPLOYMENT_FAILED (from DeploymentRunService.run) and IMAGE_UPDATE_FAILED (scheduler): two notifications and webhooks per failure. Notification message uses raw reason codes (UNHEALTHY_ROLLED_BACK...). ImageUpdateStore keeps only in-memory results so 'Update available' stays stale until the next 6h check after an applied update. ImageAutoUpdateSchedulerTest lacks a partial-pin case (2 services, 1 known digest). Scheduler processes deployments sequentially (a 2 min health wait delays others).
acceptance_criteria: One notification per failure, readable messages, update flag refreshed after apply, partial-pin test.

title: Token revoked mid-stream: async redispatch writes 401 into a committed response
description: ApiTokenAuthenticationFilter.doFilterInternal now filters ASYNC dispatch; a token revoked or expired while a stream is running makes entryPoint.commence write 401 into an already committed response (harmless IOException/ignored write).
acceptance_criteria: Filter skips re-validation once the response is committed, or the case is covered by a test.

title: Shared binary/multipart fetch helper; move saveBlob to shared
description: apiFetch is JSON only; there are now three hand-rolled fetch/XHR paths for files and multipart (settings/api.ts requestBackup, containers/files/api.ts uploadFile, volumes/backup.ts) duplicating error parsing and CSRF handling. saveBlob lives in features/settings/api.ts and is imported cross-feature. Volume backups are buffered fully in memory as a Blob.
acceptance_criteria: One shared helper for blob download and multipart upload with CSRF and error parsing; saveBlob in shared/; existing callers migrated.

title: Volume backup UI: small UX gaps (empty schedule form, busy guard, file picker, duplicated formatter)
description: frontend/src/features/volumes: BackupSchedulesDialog submit silently does nothing when the environment has no volumes (disable Add or hint); VolumesPage Backup menu item has no in-flight guard; RestoreVolumeDialog uses a bare file input (no shared FileField); LastBackupBadge.tsx and VolumesPage.tsx define identical Intl.DateTimeFormat.
acceptance_criteria: Add disabled with hint for empty volumes; in-flight guard on Backup; shared formatter.

title: VolumeArchiveValidator: forward-reference symlink and super-linear prefix checks
description: VolumeArchiveValidator.java resolveTarget: a symlink target accepted lexically (s -> sub/..) can escape the root if a later entry makes sub a symlink (sub -> .); writes through s are rejected and extraction is chrooted in the helper, so low risk. Also per-entry cost is O(segments x length) (bounded by 128 x 4096) once a link was seen; a prefix trie would make it linear. Some unusual legitimate backups (targets through directory symlinks, hard links to hard-link names) are rejected conservatively.
acceptance_criteria: Forward references rejected or resolved at the end of the scan; linear-time check; boundary tests for exactly 128 segments / 4096 chars.

title: Volume restore: in-use check races with container start; .backup-*.part files never pruned
description: VolumeArchiveServiceImpl: a container can start between the in-use check and the restore (advisory check). VolumeBackupStore: a crash between createTempFile and the atomic move leaves .backup-*.part files that nothing prunes.
acceptance_criteria: Stale .part files removed at scheduler start or by retention; race documented or closed.

title: Container edit keeps only one network and does not prefill current limits
description: containerForm.ts takes the first non-bridge/host network; other networks of a multi-network container are dropped on edit (UI shows a warning). ContainerDetailsDto also lacks memory/cpu so the resource limits form cannot show current values. Anonymous volumes appear as named mounts (hash names). Backend spec has a single network.
acceptance_criteria: Spec supports several networks and recreate reconnects them; inspect exposes memory/cpu and the limits form prefills them.

title: Container edit: image-baked env is sent back as explicit env
description: frontend/src/features/containers/containerForm.ts (formFromDetails env): inspect env includes variables baked into the image; an edit posts them as explicit env, so a newer image's changed defaults are overridden by the old values after an image change. Needs a way to tell image env from user env.
acceptance_criteria: Edit sends only user-set env (or marks image env), test with image change.

title: Leftover *-shipir-old-* container if Shipir dies during recreate
description: ContainerServiceImpl.recreateContainer: between renaming the old container and starting the new one a crash leaves a renamed old container and no startup reconciliation.
acceptance_criteria: Startup/janitor reconciles or documents recovery steps; test for the reconciliation.

title: updateResources maps any daemon 500 to UPDATE_REJECTED (409)
description: ContainerServiceImpl.updateResources catches InternalServerErrorException as UPDATE_REJECTED 'daemon refused the limits'. A genuine daemon failure is reported as a user error. Map only BadRequest/specific messages.
acceptance_criteria: Genuine 500 yields a 502-style daemon error; refused limits still 409; tests for both.

title: User access dialog needs 1+N+N requests to show inherited team grants
description: frontend/src/features/settings/UserAccessDialog.tsx (InheritedTeams/TeamName/TeamGrants): GET /teams, then GET /teams/{id} per team to check membership, then GET /teams/{id}/permissions per team the user is in. Scales with the number of teams.
acceptance_criteria: One backend endpoint (e.g. GET /api/users/{id}/teams with grants) replaces the per-team requests; dialog test still shows names and levels.

title: Team name uniqueness is case-insensitive in the service but case-sensitive in the DB
description: TeamService.create/rename check existsByNameIgnoreCase, but V26 constraint teams_name_key is case-sensitive. Two concurrent creates of 'Ops' and 'ops' can both succeed. Low risk (ADMIN-only endpoint).
acceptance_criteria: A new migration adds a unique index on lower(name) for teams; test shows the DB rejects 'Ops' and 'ops'.

title: LoginPage readOidcError has a side effect in useState initializer
description: frontend/src/features/auth/LoginPage.tsx: readOidcError calls history.replaceState inside a useState initializer (double-invoked by StrictMode in dev); also inconsistent indentation of the showLocal fragment.
acceptance_criteria: Moved to useEffect/ref, formatting fixed

title: OIDC usernames unique case-sensitively
description: auth/oidc/OidcUserResolver.freeUsername: IdP name 'Admin' can coexist with 'admin', which confuses audit entries.
acceptance_criteria: Username clash check is case-insensitive

title: CSP connect-src allows any ws:/wss: origin
description: Severity: LOW. Files: common/config/SecurityConfig.java:62-66 and frontend/nginx/security-headers.inc.template: connect-src 'self' ws: wss:. Wildcard scheme sources let injected script open WebSocket connections to any host (data exfiltration channel); 'self' already covers same-origin ws in current browsers (Safari fixed in 15.4+). No XSS sink found in the frontend (no dangerouslySetInnerHTML, no markdown renderer), so this only weakens defense in depth.
acceptance_criteria: connect-src is 'self' only (e2e CSP test and nginx header check updated in both places; verify STOMP over /ws still connects in Chromium, Firefox, Safari) or the exception is documented.

title: Trusted-proxy setup needs a known frontend address
description: shipir.security.trusted-proxies has no entry in application.yml (works via env binding only) and compose gives the frontend no fixed IP, so the address must be looked up after up. Consider a fixed subnet/IP or CIDR support.
acceptance_criteria: Documented default works without manual lookup.
notes: Security impact filed in shipr-6zf (default stack: one shared login-throttle bucket, 20 failed logins lock everyone out for 15 min).

title: Test bases delete git_credentials before deployments
description: Test setUp methods that delete git_credentials before deployments break (FK RESTRICT) once a test leaves a deployment referencing a credential. WriteToolsTest was reordered in shipr-5r1; other bases (grep 'delete from git_credentials') may have the same latent problem.
acceptance_criteria: All test cleanup deletes deployments before git_credentials.

title: AiToolRegistry generic failure log hides the exception message
description: ai/tools/AiToolRegistry.java (~line 232): the RuntimeException fallback logs only the class name, which made a PathValidationException hard to find. Log the message at DEBUG (never args or secrets).
acceptance_criteria: Unexpected tool failure logs class plus message at DEBUG; no secrets in the log; test or log-capture check.

title: Model Policy blurs epic planning (Opus) with wave planning in next-task-plan (Sonnet)
description: CLAUDE.md Model Policy: 'Planning uses Opus' lists breaking work into tasks, while next-task-plan part 2 (waves, file sets) now runs on the Sonnet orchestrator. A reader may think wave planning needs Opus.
acceptance_criteria: Model Policy states that next-task-plan wave planning is orchestration (Sonnet).

title: openssl backup check needs OpenSSL 3, macOS LibreSSL lacks dgst -mac
description: BackupService Javadoc CLI sequence uses openssl dgst -mac HMAC; /usr/bin/openssl on macOS (LibreSSL) does not support it.
acceptance_criteria: README names the OpenSSL 3 prerequisite or offers a portable verifier.
notes: README now documents the OpenSSL 3 prerequisite (shipr-29z docs)

title: Deduplicate login helper in compose API tests
description: compose/template/TemplateApiTest duplicates the login helper of compose/generator/ComposeGeneratorApiTest.
acceptance_criteria: One shared test helper used by both.

title: App templates use fixed host ports that clash
description: backend/src/main/resources/templates/apps.json: nginx 8080, wordpress 8081, adminer 8082, uptime-kuma 3001. Two templates (or the same twice) on one host fail at compose up with a port clash.
acceptance_criteria: Picker warns about or lets the user change host ports before create.

title: SearchService worker threads drop SystemScope
description: backend/src/main/java/dev/bethge/shipir/host/SearchService.java live(). The worker threads copy only the SecurityContext, so a system-scoped caller (ScopedValue SystemScope) would see nothing on them. HTTP callers are unaffected today.
acceptance_criteria: Either SystemScope is propagated to the workers or the limitation is documented and tested.
